name: Bocchi Musume x Produce Keikaku.
original_name: ボッチムスメ×プロデュース計画。
source:
Tachibana Ema is a tall, gloomy and unsociable girl with a bad case of resting bitch-face. With all that working against her, she's never really had any friends. At school, everyone's too scared to approach her.

But Ema herself is quite content with that state of affairs. In fact, she was all set to spend the rest of her time until graduation invisible as ever...

That is, until two men turned her life upside down!

"It's you... I've finally found you! You are, without a doubt, MY MUSE!"

Hiraizumi Miki—recently returned to Japan from abroad, he's loved making clothes ever since he was a little kid. He has a strong desire to help make charming, unusual women shine. (He's also a bit of a masochist.)

"Listen up, twerp! You're no good the way you are now. But even you have some potential to shine... I'll just have to polish you up!"

And Shinjou Saito—he frequently finds himself bored because things have always come easy to him. He aspires to accomplish something so big, it'll change the world. (He's also a bit of a sadist.)

These two ambitious and attractive fellows decide to give Tachibana Ema a makeover!

But Ema has other ideas.

"Yeah, well... Who asked you?!”

[Edited from [URL=http://mangagamer.org/misslonesome/]MangaGamer[/URL]]
translation:
橘绘麻是个身材高挑、阴郁而不合群的女孩，总是一副臭脸。种种因素叠加之下，她从来没有朋友；在学校里，大家都害怕接近她。

但绘麻本人对这种状态相当满意。事实上，她原本打算默默无闻地度过剩下的学生时光，直到毕业……

然而，两个男人彻底颠覆了她的人生！

“是你……我终于找到你了！你毫无疑问就是我的缪斯！”

平泉美树最近从国外回到日本，从小就喜欢做衣服。他强烈渴望让迷人而与众不同的女性绽放光彩。（他还有一点受虐倾向。）

“听着，小鬼！你现在这样可不行。但就算是你，也有闪耀的潜力……我只要把你打磨出来就行了！”

新城斋藤总是因为一切都来得太容易而感到无聊。他渴望完成足以改变世界的大事。（他还有一点施虐倾向。）

这两个野心勃勃又富有魅力的男人决定为橘绘麻改头换面！

但绘麻另有打算。

“是啊，可谁问你了？！”
